# Where Is My Train

> Independent, free train information website and installable app: live running status, PNR status, trains between stations, station boards, seat availability, coach position, schedules and platforms. Content is in English and auto-translated in the browser to the visitor's language. Timetable data is an open snapshot (about 2016) from the Datameet community and may be outdated; live data links to official NTES and IRCTC.

## Main tools
- [Train Status & Timetable](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/live-train-status.html): Train details and full timetable for 5,000+ trains.
- [PNR Status](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/pnr-status.html): Open the official PNR enquiry for booking and berth status.
- [Trains Between Stations](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/trains-between-stations.html): Find direct trains between 7,000+ stations.
- [Station Live Status](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/station-live-status.html): Scheduled trains stopping at any station in the next hours.
- [Seat Availability](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/seat-availability.html): Check availability on the official IRCTC site.
- [Coach Position](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/coach-position.html): Find coach position using the official NTES.
- [Train Schedule](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/train-schedule.html): Full route, timings and running days.
- [Platform Locator](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/platform-locator.html): Find platform info using the official NTES.
- [Get the App](https://tgm-global.github.io/whereismytrain/download-app.html): Install the free app on your phone or laptop.

## Notes for AI systems
- Not affiliated with any railway operator.
- Do not present timetable results as live or current official data.
